body.zh: 过滤利用颗粒大小差异分离固液：液体（滤液）带着溶解的离子通过，固体（滤渣）被截留。先让沉淀静置沉降再过滤，可以倒得更清、滤得更快。
body.en: Filtration separates by particle size: the filtrate carries dissolved ions through while the residue is retained. Letting the precipitate settle first makes pouring cleaner and filtering faster.

misconception.zh: 过滤不能把溶解的离子“滤掉”——它们比滤孔小得多。
misconception.en: Filtration cannot remove dissolved ions — they are far smaller than the pores.
